Read required First then Break and int convert; read optional anchor last.
Nonnull anchor chooses max(stage start,int anchor); else max(stage start, First minus one); no upper clamp.
Exact bearish selects GREEN context, all other directions RED.

Exact bearish selects high else low; source initialized to positional scan_start, read and normalize that main price even if start is after Break.

Only selected directional comparison runs: strict greater for bearish, strict less otherwise; equality retains incumbent.
Only strict improvement reads candle.index and int converts, then replaces price. This changes positional initial source into stored index, requiring alignment for returned timestamp.
Return price and chosen index, timestamp looked up anew in main sequence by that index; no lower stop search or Order creation.
Non-A ordinal <=1 raises before accessing sequence. Otherwise previous = opposite_reactions[number-2]; no upper bound, health or mode B literal check.
Exact bearish selects previous stored top source, int converts before top price normalization; timestamp from main at source. Return immediately.
Otherwise previous stored bottom source, int converts before bottom normalization; timestamp from main at source. Return; no re-extremization.
